title.tr: Kiremit renkli şiltli çatılı sekizgen ahşap kamelya, bank ve taş döşeme
title.en: Octagonal timber gazebo with a tile-coloured shingle roof, a bench and paving

alt.tr: Kiremit renkli şilte çatılı sekizgen ahşap kamelya, cam üst bölüm, kafes alt paneller, bank ve taş döşeme
alt.en: Octagonal timber gazebo with a tile-coloured shingle roof, a glazed upper section, lattice lower panels, a bench and paving

caption.tr: Çatı tepede sivrilerek bitiyor, alt kısım kafes panellerle örülü. Çevrede bank ve toprak saksı var.
caption.en: The roof narrows to a point at the top and the lower part is filled with lattice panels. A bench and a terracotta planter stand nearby.
